title: Research
description: Research synthesis document (doc_type=research). Captures a single verified finding, its provenance, the claims behind it with verification status (including the doc's own self-corrections), and what to do next. Spine is invariant and board-queryable; body is free for the instance-specific argument. Sibling of the service-design definition-layer schemas (legion #526); shape validated against real instances in vault-2026 (first: legion doc 019ec353).

track.description: Research track this belongs to (e.g. understanding track / discover-v3)

finding.description: The one-sentence conclusion. Every research doc has exactly one. Spine, not body -- BOARD answers 'what did each doc conclude' from this field alone. eavesdrop's was 'the_bet'.

premise.description: The question or problem state the research addresses.

provenance.description: How this document was made. Leads the doc; honesty about method is load-bearing.

source_workflow.description: Run id + scale (agents, tokens, dimensions scanned, verify ratio)

tool_limits.description: What the run could not do (e.g. Bash/grep denied; reconstructed from structured result)

claims.description: The claims behind the finding -- INCLUDING the doc's own refuted/self-corrected claims, not only survivors. A research doc that lists only what held launders its honesty into prose.

is_self_correction.description: True when this claim refutes or corrects an earlier claim in the same research line (e.g. a completeness critic)

evidence.description: Structured evidence link, house-style. Corpus chunk, file:line, or workflow ref.

locator.description: file:line or doc#path for non-URL evidence

novelty.description: Honest novelty -- what was invented vs assembled.

caveats.description: Known failure modes, kill-conditions, mandatory ablations.

next_step.description: Decision-tree handoff: what the next agent should DO.

build_gate.description: What must be true before production code (e.g. do-not-build-yet + the pretest that gates it)

cross_repo.description: Board-actionable dependencies on other repos. Distinct from semantic links[]: these are time-sensitive grafts the BOARD tracks.

blocking_issues.description: Issue-state conditions, e.g. 'before #63/#64 land' -- the real deadline is often an issue state, not a calendar date

links.description: Cross-artifact graph edges, shared house-style link layer. Use to trace research FORWARD into the personas/blueprints/requirements it informs.

body.description: Instance-specific argument: theses, architecture, proposals. Free shape.
